We’re Hiring for US | Enterprise Presales Consultant

 Location: USA
 Experience: 8+ Years
 Domain: Telecom | CPaaS | Network APIs | Enterprise Solutions

Role Overview:
We are looking for an Enterprise Presales Consultant to drive end-to-end presales activities for enterprise customers. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery, and customers to design and present scalable communication and network solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
· Own the end-to-end enterprise presales cycle, from discovery to solution               design and deal closure.
· Understand customer requirements, use cases, technical expectations, and business objectives.
· Design end-to-end solution architectures aligned with customer needs and network constraints.
· Present and position CPaaS solutions, including SMS, Voice, WhatsApp, OTP, and APIs.
· Work with Network APIs / NaaS capabilities such as Identity, Location, QoS, Authentication, and Charging.
· Conduct customer workshops, product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, RFPs and RFIs.
· Engage with CXOs, IT Heads, Digital teams, and enterprise stakeholders.
· Collaborate with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams to develop customer solutions.
· Prepare BoQs, solution costing, pricing inputs, technical commercials, and proposals.
· Provide customer and market feedback to Product teams and track competitor offerings.

Required Skills:
· 8+ years of experience in Enterprise Presales, Solution Consulting, or Solution Architecture.
· Strong experience in Telecom / CPaaS / Digital Communications.
· Hands-on understanding of APIs, Messaging, Voice, WhatsApp Business, OTP, and enterprise communication workflows.
· Knowledge of telecom networks, cloud platforms, APIs, and enterprise IT integrations.
· Experience with BoQ, solution costing, RFP/RFI responses, workshops, and demos.
· Exposure to Network APIs / NaaS is highly desirable.
· Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and       enterprise relationship-building skills.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Telecom / IT / Computer Science or equivalent.

Interested candidates can DM me for further discussion and or share there updated CV at: [public email redacted]

#USA #NorthUSA
